definitions.explanation: Made or put together in a hurry, usually before a noun with の. It often implies the result is rough or only temporary.

examples.japanese: {急|きゅう}ごしらえ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{舞台|ぶたい}→舞台：03606_butai⟧。
{急|きゅう}ごしらえ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: We played the match with a team thrown together in a hurry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、⟦{体育館|たいいくかん}→体育館：03111_taiikukan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{急|きゅう}ごしらえ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{避難所|ひなんじょ}→避難所：07374_hinanjo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{作|つく}られた→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: After the disaster, a makeshift shelter was set up in the gym.

notes:
From ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧ (sudden, urgent) + こしらえ (making, from こしらえる).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {急|きゅう}ごしらえ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{小屋|こや}→小屋：02768_koya⟧: a makeshift hut
- {急|きゅう}ごしらえ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧: a plan cobbled together

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{即席|そくせき}→即席：11826_sokuseki⟧: instant, improvised; neutral, without the sense of roughness
- ⟦{付|つ}け{焼|や}き{刃|ば}→付け焼き刃：20506_tsukeyakiba⟧: a hastily acquired, superficial skill
